findings.title: 4 requests deep
findings.message: s0 → s1 → s2 → s3 → s4: each waits for the next, so all 5 must be up, and their latencies add up. Making the last call a message means s0 no longer waits for s4.

output.hint: To fix one, send its fix.ops to edit_diagram as they are (one undo step). Only the person can ignore a finding.
